description: This is the main React component for a web application built with Next.js, handling UI for uploading documents, managing persona data, orchestrating backend interactions such as generating and saving personas, displaying status, version history, and user interactions. It includes hooks for polling backend status, managing state, rendering various UI states, and handling file uploads and persona editing.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Type representing the UI state of the application ('initial', 'processing', 'draft', 'finalized')

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Interface representing a work experience entry for a persona, including id, role, company, date, description

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: Interface representing persona details including name, title, summary, skills, experiences, education, certifications, tools, industries, years of experience, and career highlights

classes.name: UploadedFileData
classes.description: Interface for uploaded file data with id and File object

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Utility to convert unknown value to string array, filtering out non-string or empty strings

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Serializes a value to formatted JSON string, safely handling errors

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable message from various error types

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object with at least one key

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a label string for avatar display

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses nested values within an object given a path array, returning value and found path

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs to console the keys present in the provided object for debugging orchestration payloads

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from orchestration record, looking into multiple candidate paths and applying heuristics

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into UI's legacy PersonaData structure, handling nested and alternate fields

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component for the persona builder workflow, managing document uploads, orchestration, persona editing, status polling, version control, status/error handling, and UI rendering
